defs.def: the impression that a person, an organization or a product, etc. gives to the public 形象；印象；声誉

ex.s: The image of the reader appears throughout history, in art made long before books as we now know them came into being.
ex.t: 读者的形象贯穿整个历史，出现在远早于我们今天所熟知的书籍诞生之前的艺术作品中。

ex.s: Researchers use brain imaging technique to see which brain areas light up when we view paintings that we consider beautiful.
ex.t: 研究人员使用脑成像技术来观察当我们观看我们认为美丽的画作时，哪些大脑区域会被激活。

ex.s: In all, 80 examinations were conducted for the project between January and September, 2019, focusing on the imaging procedures that would cause anxiety.
ex.t: 2019年1月至9月间，该项目共进行了80次检查，重点关注会引起焦虑的成像流程。

ex.s: Movies of course need impressive images, so why has Alice in Wonderland only resulted in movies best described as “interesting”?
ex.t: 电影当然需要令人印象深刻的图像，那么为什么《爱丽丝梦游仙境》只产生了最多只能说是有趣的电影？

defs.def: a mental picture that you have of what sb/sth is like or looks like （心目中的）形象，印象

ex.s: To improve the quality of observational data, biodiversity apps can also encourage users to have an expert confirm the identification of their uploaded image.”
ex.t: 为了提高观察数据的质量，生物多样性应用还可以鼓励用户请专家确认其上传图片的物种鉴定。”

ex.s: Please be aware that you will not receive this smart card during Welcome Week if you do not upload your image online by 4 September 2020.
ex.t: 请注意如果你不在2020年9月4日之前在线上传你的照片你在迎新周期间将不会收到这张智能卡。

defs.def: a copy of sb/sth in the form of a picture or statue 画像；雕像；塑像
a picture of sb/sth seen in a mirror, through a camera, or on a television or computer 镜像；影像；映像；图像

ex.s: SLEAP uses computer vision (the ability for computers to understand images) and deep learning (an AI approach for training a computer to learn and work like the human brain) to help researchers process images much more quickly.
ex.t: SLEAP利用计算机视觉（计算机理解图像的能力）和深度学习（一种训练计算机像人脑一样学习和工作的AI方法），帮助研究人员更快地处理图像。

ex.s: I can, from my computer at home, pull up satellite images of Juan’s village.
ex.t: 在我们的社会中，我们知道地球只有一个月亮。

ex.s: For the images that an artist creates, viewers will probably get far more enjoyment once they know the process used to create them.
ex.t: 对于艺术家创作的图像，观众一旦了解了创作过程，可能会获得更多的享受。

ex.s: The researchers then tested the dogs’ ability to distinguish between human facial expressions by showing them the other half of the person’s face or images totally different from the ones used in training.
ex.t: 随后，研究人员给狗展示人脸的另一半，或展示与训练时完全不同的图像，测试狗区分人类面部表情的能力。

ex.s: That might mean either developing a uniform way to mark videos and images, showing when and who they were made by. or abandoning phone calls altogether and moving towards data-based communications—using apps like Face Time or WhatsApp, which can be tied to your identity.
ex.t: 这可能意味着要么制定一种统一的方式来标记视频和图像，标明其制作时间和制作者；要么完全放弃电话通话，转向基于数据的通信——使用能与你的身份绑定在一起的Face Time或WhatsApp等应用程序。

ex.s: To generate plant images.
ex.t: 为了生成植物图像。

ex.s: Informed by neuroaesthetics, the next time I create my art I will value the process even more, enjoying the activation of the aesthetic triad in my brain as I admire the vivid images that I have created.
ex.t: 受神经美学的启发，下次创作艺术时，我将更加重视创作过程，在欣赏我创造的生动图像的同时，享受大脑审美三元组的激活。

ex.s: An advanced brain imaging technology.
ex.t: 一种先进的脑成像技术。

ex.s: They are winter images.
ex.t: 它们是冬季图像。

ex.s: Images of Iraqi children．B.
ex.t: 伊拉克儿童的图像．B.

ex.s: an image saved as a PDF file
ex.t: 保存为PDF文件的图像

ex.s: My most frightening but magical experience was now captured forever in a single image.
ex.t: 我最可怕但也最神奇的经历现在永远地凝固在一张照片里了。

ex.s: Make the most of these images to look for clues to help you understand the text.
ex.t: 充分利用这些图像来寻找线索，帮助你理解文本。

ex.s: The Time Machine A faint blue light shot across it, darkening to purple, and presently she could see the image of her son, who lived on the other side of the earth, and he could see her.
ex.t: 《时间机器》：一道微弱的蓝光穿过它，渐渐变成紫色，很快她看到了住在世界另一边的儿子的影像，他也能看到她。

ex.s: Then I tried some 2________, that is, making images out of paper.
ex.t: 然后我尝试了纸艺，也就是用纸做图像。

defs.def: a word or phrase used with a different meaning from its normal one, in order to describe sth in a way that produces a strong picture in the mind 比喻；意象
